newsitem.title: UK: DFDS FLIES DINOSAUR MODELS FOR LOST WORLD.
newsitem.headline: DFDS FLIES DINOSAUR MODELS FOR LOST WORLD.

text.p: DFDS Transport said its airfreight division has just transported 840 dinosaur display models from the UK to Europe and Latin America for a series of promotional launches of the firm The Lost World - the sequel to Jurassic Park.
DFDS Transport is a UK based multi-modal firm and part of the Danish DFDS group.

Made by Hinton Corrpak , the six foot fibreboard models were palletised because of their awkward shape before being flown in dedicated carriers to countries including Spain, Portugal, Belgium, Greece. Mexico, Argentina, Chile and Colombia. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
